raw_text:
*If You Love your Country, Read till End*

Till 2024 (pre-AI revolution), India was largely running on autopilot, guided by the economic policies of Narasimha Rao, Vajpayee, and Manmohan Singh.

The model was straightforward: India had a huge population and a massive demographic dividend. 

American companies gained access to a young, low-cost workforce, creating a win-win situation for India through outsourcing and IT/services growth.

However, till 2024, I saw no major new economic policy breakthroughs or bold reforms from the current government.

Now, after 2024, the AI revolution has truly begun and India has missed the bus once again.

In the coming years, our huge population could become a liability rather than an asset if AI replaces many of the routine jobs and services we currently provide. 

Why would American companies continue sending work and money here if AI can do it cheaper, faster, and better?

This explains why FIIs are pulling out and why the Indian market has delivered negative returns in recent times.

If this continues, we are not going to become a superpower by 2047. The risks ahead are far greater than most people realise.

India urgently needs major policy changes.

But no one seems to be listening and it appears they won’t listen either.

quote.content:
Respected Late Sheila Dikshit Ma'am,

-This Post is to Say a Thank You for Making Delhi into a Truly Global City.

You Were the Reason for :-

➡️Building Most number of the Flyovers (170) in Delhi which was made Almost Free of Traffic Lights.

➡️Building 200 km+ of Delhi-NCR Metro, which almost Transferred the Infrastructure.

➡️Successfully transitioned 65,000 Diesel running Buses/Autos into CNG.

➡️Successfully Relocated Polluting Industries Out of the City.

➡️Air Pollution Level in Delhi was Reduced by 200% because of these Developments.

➡️Breaking free from Routine 8-10 hours of power cuts Every day.

➡️Hosting World Largest Commonwealth Games 2010.

After All these Developments, You Got Humiliated by Fake narratives from Indian Media and In Return We Voted You Out without thinking twice !!

And Now We Realised that Our Delhi has been Suffering from Worst Air Pollution and No one is trying to Reduce it. Central Government is Busy with PR management, Election Rallies and Raiding here and there. We are truly Missing Your Governance !!

Thanks Once Again !!
